title: Evidence Record
description: One machine-readable outcome for one executed test, per spec.md FR-003/FR-004 and data-model.md.

assertion_summary.description: The real, specific checked outcome. MUST NOT be one of the forbidden generic strings — see anti-bluff-validate.sh rule (a) in research.md R-009.

raw_output_ref.description: Relative path to captured stdout/stderr. MUST exist and be non-empty (R-009 rule c).

anti_bluff_status.description: Written only by anti-bluff-validate.sh, never by the test itself.
